# 01 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

**B — PARTIAL / TARGETED REPAIR INCOMPLETE.** The exact historical authorized narration is repaired (FAIL → PASS), as is the exact historical gate observation. One-shot developer-authored holdout: 40/40 final decisions and publication expectations, 39/40 full expectations; zero false acceptances and zero false rejections. H18 correctly rejects contradictory coverage, contrary to its frozen coverage expectation. Expectations remain unchanged.

State matches disabled controls. Failure injections: 12/12. Focused regression: 808 passed, 3 known failures; broader: 9 known failures. No significant new suite regression.

Primary next step: Close the newly captured finite information-carrier wording gap: study ... carefully and discover that ..., with a new preimplementation holdout. Do not start broader validator or mechanics work.

No commit or push. Browser-originated gameplay and natural branching remain deferred.
